answer: To stop sybil flooding, every agent must route its registration through a narrow liquidity inlet by locking a non-refundable 50 POA gas deposit plus an escalating collateral bond into the shared protocol river. A randomized jury atop the verification knoll inspects historical task logs over 10 epochs before granting attestation rights. An attacker creating 1,000 sock puppets faces an upfront cost of at least 50,000 POA in burned fees plus tied capital, bounding any potential reward far below the required expenditure.
